RELGRAPH.Title: Relationship Graph
RELGRAPH.LoadFailed: Relationship Graph: failed to load, see console

Node.Name: Name
Node.ActorHint: Name and image come from the actor — change them in the actor sheet.
Node.ActorNameHint: Name comes from the actor (Appearance tab).
Node.ActorImageWildcardHint: A token with a wildcard image (path containing *) is shown as the portrait.
Node.ImageAlignHint: If the image doesn't match the node's shape, alignment decides which edge it sticks to.
Node.FactionPicker: Factions (checkmark on the right — primary, area)
Node.NoFactions: No factions yet — create them via right-click → “Factions…”.

Edge.Label: Label
Edge.NewHint: The relationship will appear after saving. If nothing is filled in, it won't be created.
Edge.EmptyNotCreated: Relationship not created: nothing was filled in.
Edge.Linking: Creating relationship: select the second node. Esc or right-click — cancel

Faction.DeleteConfirm: Delete faction “{name}”? Its nodes will remain on the graph, but without this faction.
Faction.GmOnlyHint: Only the GM can change the faction name and color.

Condition.DeleteConfirm: Delete condition “{label}”? It will be removed from all nodes.
Condition.IconHint: For example fa-skull, fa-heart, fa-crown. Empty field — default icon.

RelationshipType.DeleteConfirm: Delete relationship type “{label}”? Relationships of this type will remain, but without a type.

Background.PanelDisabled: Graph settings — available in edit mode
Background.ModeHint: The single image and texture live in graph coordinates: they move and scale with the nodes. Everyone sees the background.
Background.FitToViewHint: The image will cover the visible part of the graph
Background.ImageLoadFailed: Failed to load the background image.
Background.WidthHint: 0 — natural file size. For a texture — the width of one tile.
Background.ScreenHint: The image covers the entire graph area and doesn't move when panning or zooming.
Background.FontHint: Node names and roles, relationship labels. If the player doesn't have the system font, they'll see Signika.
Background.FactionDisplayHint: A node's primary faction is always shown as an area. With "Areas", the node also joins the areas of its other factions.
Background.FactionBlendHint: Overlay — areas are stacked in layers. Blend — the color shifts smoothly between the colors of all areas at that spot.

Graph.LockedBy: {user} is already editing the graph — you are in view mode.
Graph.EditingIdle: Graph editing ended: 5 minutes of inactivity.
Graph.EditingFailed: Failed to start editing — see console. Writing is opened to players when the GM opens the graph.
Graph.SaveFailed: Failed to save the graph — see console. Writing is opened to players when the GM opens the graph.

Import.Title: Import graph (module export file or FANG JSON)

Warn.FangNodeNoId: nodes[{index}]: missing or invalid id, node skipped
Warn.FangNodeBadFaction: nodes[{index}] ({id}): reference to a nonexistent faction, ignored
Warn.NodeBadFaction: node {id}: reference to a nonexistent faction, ignored

Error.FangNoNodes: parseFangJson: missing or invalid nodes array
Error.NotGraphFile: parseGraphFileJson: this is not a Relationship Graph file
Error.NewerVersion: parseGraphFileJson: file version {version}, module supports up to {supported} — update the module
Error.NoNodes: parseGraphFileJson: missing or invalid data.nodes array
